    The additive-generator Auslander equivalence #

    For an object G in an idempotent-complete additive category, the representable functor Hom(G,-) identifies add(G) with the additive retract closure of the regular representable module Hom(G,G).

    This is the exact generic foundation needed for Iyama's minimal realization in the magnitude campaign. It is a bounded adaptation of the corresponding core in the clean equidistribution formalization; no OP-conjecture module or classification layer is imported.
